about: The reviewed list of ADR 0027: everything a conformance baseline (2025-11-25.yaml, 2026-07-28.yaml beside this file) may excuse, each with why. fixtureScenarios are whole scenarios that call the referee's own fixture tools, prompts, resources or capabilities, which the relay does not serve and should not. fixtureChecks are single checks, in scenarios whose other checks must pass, that need one of the referee's diagnostic fixture tools; a run fails if one of them fails for any reason but a fixture the relay lacks. shouldWarnings are single SHOULD-level checks; a run fails if one of them fails as anything but a warning. Nothing here may name dns-rebinding-protection or http-header-validation, and nothing may excuse a MUST-level check of a scenario that does not depend on the referee's fixtures. test/conformance-baselines.test.ts holds both baselines to this list and this list to those rules; change it only in a reviewed commit.

shouldWarnings.server-stateless:sep-2575-server-sends-t: SHOULD notify a listen stream when the tool list changes; the suite changes the list through the referee's fixture, and the relay's own notifications are tested in packages/relay/test/page-tools-notify.test.ts and tests/e2e/test/revisions.test.ts
shouldWarnings.sep-2164-resource-not-found:sep-2164-err: SHOULD answer -32602 for a resource that does not exist; the relay serves no resources, so resources/read is an unknown method (-32601)
shouldWarnings.sep-2164-resource-not-found:sep-2164-dat: SHOULD name the missing resource's URI in the error; the relay serves no resources

shouldWarnings.input-required-result-missing-input-resp: SHOULD re-request missing inputResponses; the suite asks it of the referee's fixture tool test_input_required_result_elicitation
